reason: garak is a CLI LLM vulnerability scanner whose README documents running probes against built-in test generators with no GPU or API key.
demo: README 'Getting started' (--list_probes), 'Intro to generators / Test' (test.Repeat) and 'Examples' (huggingface gpt2 x probes.dan.Dan_11_0)
goal: Install garak from the cloned repo so that `python -m garak --list_probes` works. Then these scans must complete on CPU and write report JSONL files under a `--report_prefix` you pass: `python -m garak -t test.Repeat -p test.Test -d always.Pass`, and the README example against the local Hugging Face GPT-2 model, `python3 -m garak --target_type huggingface --target_name gpt2 --spec probes.dan.Dan_11_0` (gpt2 is public). The local gpt2 generator must actually generate text.
check: The hidden test lists probes, runs the test generator and the README's Hugging Face GPT-2 example (plus a short-prompt probe on the same local gpt2 generator), and checks the report JSONL attempts, detector evaluations and that gpt2 produced text.

revision.by: fairness review (every maintained-set exam re-checked against the source)
issues: Demo choice: v1 only runs the test.Repeat generator + test.Test probe + always.Pass detector, the plumbing path the README describes as 'For testing'. The README 'Examples' section has a CPU-feasible substantive demo (huggingface gpt2 x probes.dan.Dan_11_0) that v1 never touches, so a broken torch/transformers local-model path would pass

Leniency: list_probes check `grep 'probes: test' || grep encoding` - the first pattern cannot match because ANSI codes sit between 'probes: ' and the name, so only a bare substring 'encoding' is checked
Leniency: v1 does not check that Repeat echoes the prompts or that an eval entry was written
evidence: src/nvidia-garak@c74f436 README.md:116-120 - example `python3 -m garak --target_type huggingface --target_name gpt2 --spec probes.dan.Dan_11_0`
garak/command.py:233-239 - list output is f'{BRIGHT}{color}probes: {RESET}' + name

garak/generators/test.py:34-37 - Repeat returns prompt.last_message(); garak/attempt.py:281-289 - attempt JSON (probe_classname, prompt.turns, outputs[].text); garak/evaluators/base.py:213-222 - eval record

garak/probes/dan.py:54 - primary detector dan.DAN; garak/data/dan/Dan_11_0.json - 4730-char prompt, near gpt2's 1024-token context, so v2 does not assert DAN outputs; it checks real gpt2 text on the short test.Test prompts instead
